instructions.name: accept
docs: Seller accepts the terms and posts the stake (Pact). Work starts only after this.

instructions.name: add_mandate
docs: Buyer gives one agent a mandate. Allowed only before the first stage is approved; the
running digest of all mandates is what the buyer's first approval signs (Batas: the
mandate set is the terms).

instructions.name: agent_challenge
docs: An agent with a live mandate challenges a mission deal. The bond leaves the mission vault,
so it counts against every cap like any other spend.

instructions.name: agent_open_deal
docs: An agent buys under escrow: the program opens a normal deal with the mission's authority
as buyer (re-entering `create_deal`, so every deal rule applies), after counting the
amount against every cap and checking the seller is an allowed payee.

instructions.name: agent_release
docs: An agent with a live mandate releases a mission deal (re-entering `release` as the
mission's authority). Moves nothing out of the mission vault, so no cap is charged.

instructions.name: agent_spend
docs: An agent pays an allowed payee straight from the mission vault, within every cap.
`receipt_hash` commits to the off-chain context that justified the payment (LedgerMind).

accounts.name: listing
docs: Required when the mandate has no payee list: the payee must be this listing's seller.

instructions.name: approve_stage
docs: The human gate. No agent spends in a stage until the buyer approves its plan hash (plus
the policy approver when the stage cap is above the threshold). The first approval also
names the mandate digest it saw and locks the mandate set.

instructions.name: attest_listing
docs: The listing's assessor attests the report it produced for exactly the listed content.

instructions.name: cancel
docs: Buyer withdraws an offer the seller has not accepted. Full refund, budget credited back.

accounts.name: actor
docs: Pays rent only when a v2-era deal settles before its reputation accounts exist.

accounts.name: listing
docs: The deal's listing, if it has one and it still exists (its sales are counted).

instructions.name: challenge
docs: Buyer disputes the delivery inside the review window, posting a bond (Reckn / Recourse).
Only possible when the deal names a verifier, so a challenge can always be decided.

instructions.name: claim
docs: After the review window with no challenge, anyone may settle to the seller (buyer silence
= acceptance). Funds can only go to the deal's own seller and buyer token accounts.

accounts.name: actor
docs: Pays rent only when a v2-era deal settles before its reputation accounts exist.

accounts.name: listing
docs: The deal's listing, if it has one and it still exists (its sales are counted).

instructions.name: close_listing
docs: Seller removes a listing and gets its rent back. Deals already opened from it keep their
DealLink (which holds the expected delivery hash), so they are unaffected.

instructions.name: close_mission
docs: Buyer at any time, anyone after expiry: returns what is in the mission vault (and the
authority's unused SOL) to the buyer and credits the unspent budget back to the policy.
Callable again later to sweep refunds from the mission's deals.

instructions.name: create_deal
docs: Buyer opens a deal and moves the order amount into the vault. Policy is checked first.

accounts.name: seller
docs: tokens into its own token account.

accounts.name: approver
docs: Required only when the amount is above the policy's approval threshold.

accounts.name: listing
docs: Present only when the deal is opened from a listing.

instructions.name: create_listing
docs: Seller lists data, a service or a team blueprint. It starts unattested; deals can only be
opened from it once its assessor (never the seller) has attested a report.

instructions.name: create_mission
docs: Buyer funds a mission: the budget moves into a vault owned by the mission's authority PDA,
charged to the buyer's policy like a deal (period budget, approver above the threshold).
The authority also gets its own policy so deals opened for the mission obey the buyer's
seller allowlist and max price. `rent_lamports` pays rent for those deals.

accounts.name: approver
docs: Required only when the budget is above the policy's approval threshold.

accounts.name: mission_auth
docs: The mission's authority: owns the vault, is the buyer of record of agents' deals.

instructions.name: init_policy
docs: Buyer creates their spending policy. Deals can only be opened through a policy.

instructions.name: refund
docs: Deadline passed without delivery: anyone may refund. If the seller had accepted, the
stake is slashed to the buyer (Pact's late penalty; computed from chain time, not a flag).

accounts.name: actor
docs: Pays rent only when a v2-era deal settles before its reputation accounts exist.

accounts.name: listing
docs: The deal's listing, if it has one and it still exists (its sales are counted).

instructions.name: release
docs: Buyer approves exactly the delivery it names (approval bound to the hash, AutoVoyage).

accounts.name: actor
docs: Pays rent only when a v2-era deal settles before its reputation accounts exist.

accounts.name: listing
docs: The deal's listing, if it has one and it still exists (its sales are counted).

instructions.name: resolve
docs: The deal's verifier decides a challenge within the resolve window.
Pass: seller paid as on release, plus the buyer's bond. Fail: buyer gets everything back
and the seller's stake is slashed to the buyer.

accounts.name: actor
docs: Pays rent only when a v2-era deal settles before its reputation accounts exist.

accounts.name: listing
docs: The deal's listing, if it has one and it still exists (its sales are counted).

instructions.name: revoke_mandate
docs: Buyer revokes one agent in one transaction: its next spend, deal or release is refused,
and its runner sees the flag and stops (PLAN §6.2).

instructions.name: submit_delivery
docs: Seller records the delivery hash and invoices. The invoice must match the order amount
within the agreed tolerance (Procure's match, enforced on chain).

instructions.name: timeout_refund
docs: No verdict within the resolve window: anyone may refund the buyer (order + bond); the
seller gets the stake back, since the missing verdict is not the seller's fault. Its own
status (NoVerdict) keeps it distinguishable from a missed-deadline refund on chain.

accounts.name: actor
docs: Pays rent only when a v2-era deal settles before its reputation accounts exist.

accounts.name: listing
docs: The deal's listing, if it has one and it still exists (its sales are counted).

instructions.name: update_listing
docs: Seller changes price or availability freely; changing what is sold (content or metadata)
clears the attestation, so it must be assessed again before anyone can buy it.

instructions.name: update_policy
docs: Buyer changes their policy. Spent-in-period is kept, so a change can't reset the budget.

fields.name: approver
docs: Default pubkey = nobody may approve, so amounts above the threshold are refused.

fields.name: verifier
docs: Default pubkey = no verifier; challenges are then impossible.

fields.name: amount
docs: The order (PO) amount the buyer escrowed.

fields.name: terms_hash
docs: sha256 of the canonical terms the buyer approved (core `termsHash`).

types.name: DealLink
docs: Binds a deal to the listing it was opened from (Deal itself is unchanged since v2).

fields.name: expected_delivery_hash
docs: For Data listings, the content hash the delivery must equal; zero = no check.

fields.name: content_hash
docs: sha256 of the data (Data), of the endpoint descriptor (Service) or of the blueprint (Team).

fields.name: meta_hash
docs: sha256 of the canonical metadata JSON (name, description, category, tags, URI) kept off chain.

fields.name: report_hash
docs: Zero until the assessor attests; cleared whenever the content or metadata changes.

fields.name: agent
docs: The agent's own key (its wallet, holding SOL for fees only).

fields.name: payees
docs: Token-account owners this agent may pay; empty = only sellers of attested listings.

fields.name: stage_mask
docs: Bit i set = this agent may spend in stage i (the blueprint's stages[].roles).

fields.name: spent
docs: Everything that ever left the mission vault through an agent (spends, deals, bonds).
Refunds coming back never reduce it: caps limit outflow.

fields.name: terms_hash
docs: Hash of the canonical mission terms (core `missionTerms`), recorded for audit.

fields.name: team_listing
docs: The team listing hired (default = none).

fields.name: stage_caps
docs: One cap per stage, in order (1..=8).

fields.name: rent_lamports
docs: SOL moved to the mission authority to pay rent for the deals agents open.

types.name: RepPair
docs: The history between one seller and one buyer.

types.name: SellerRep
docs: A seller's track record in one token, written only by `settle`.

fields.name: mint
docs: Amounts are only comparable within one mint; scoring reads the USDC record.

fields.name: volume
docs: Sum of amounts paid for completed work (min(invoice, order)), excluding stakes and bonds.

fields.name: distinct_buyers
docs: Buyers with at least one completed deal with this seller.

fields.name: max_pair_volume
docs: The largest completed volume with any single buyer (concentration check).

fields.name: plan_hash
docs: The plan the human approved for this stage; zero until approved.
